message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on June 18 1815 near present‑day Belgium, resulted in roughly **47,000 casualties** in total:

| Side | Approximate casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|---------------------------------------------------|
| French & allies (Napoleon’s army) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian forces (Wellington & Blücher) | ~22,000 |

These figures combine killed, wounded, and missing soldiers. Exact numbers vary slightly among contemporary reports, but most historians agree on a combined casualty count in the mid‑40,000s.
